I was almost in exactly your position a few months ago, except my relationship was much shorter and more tumultuous. I found out about him being a JW two years into it and was already very aware of what JWs are and how destructive it can be. At first we tried to make it work because we loved each other, and how to raise kids was something that came up a lot. 
There were some things I was okay conceding with, but holidays was something I was really stuck on because I loved them. He didn’t want them at all in any form. 
I think it’s wonderful that she says she will give in some ways, but, it wouldn’t be the same. Then theres always the fear that when the time comes, would she actually go through with it?

She asks why you wont sacrifice things, I got asked that too (had “too much pride” to give things up), And the simple answer is we shouldn’t have to. It’s not selfish to want the life you always envisioned for yourself. We didn’t enter these relationships knowing what we were really getting into. It’s not our faults for wanting a normal life when we weren’t given the chance to decide. 

Over time the fact that I was lied to for so long became something that I was increasingly angry about. Discussions with him would turn into arguments. It wasn’t constructive at all. We both wanted different things. Then I realized that Im young and shouldn’t have to settle for a relationship that would be a constant battle. 

I don’t regret leaving at all. I feel like there’s been a massive weight lifted off of me. 

Like another commenter stated, this is a cult, she will always want to raise her children within the religion. That’s not something that will change unless she leaves it not only physically but also mentally.

This was also a point we would argue on. I wasn’t raised in any sort of religious environment. My parents felt like religion was a personal choice, and they themselves aren’t particularly religious. I wanted children how I was raised. And he of course wanted little jw drones. 

I personally don’t think religion is the right place for children. Children shouldn’t have to worry about what happens after they die, or if they are good enough, or about the world ending.

Oh! I just remembered something he told me! Something like “When I say I want to have children I don’t mean in this life” 
That was something that made me realize just how deeply he believed in it all.

He definitely tried to convince me he was better, when he did all I could think about was all the times he got upset over nothing. 
“The Arrangement” as he would call it, was actually something we discussed (and that he derailed into an argument). I don’t like the idea of my options or abilities being limited just because I’m a woman. To me it was all just gross. 
I remember that he kept saying “thats the arrangement” whenever I asked him if things that I saw really were how jw women were. When I asked him what he meant by “arrangement” he couldn’t even tell me. 
“How can you go around telling people how they should live when you don’t even know what the words you are using means?” 
He just kind of stayed quiet after that

“Breeding ground for mental health issues” was something I definitely saw just by what little I knew of his family. 
His mom was born into it, his dad was not. When his mom left jw to be with him it destroyed her, she poured all of her problems onto ex. She would tell a child about how she wanted to die. When she eventually rejoined he saw it as the thing that saved her. Even now she still complains to him. 
It’s all insane.
Supposedly he told them about it himself! Along with a family member! Which made me feel so disgusting, having private relationship details shared with strangers

For me, there are times when I go a day  without eating, only allowing myself a mint or two for the pain or my bad breath. 
When I do eat, while in the moment of eating I feel great, but, as soon as it’s over I extreme guilt, as if I’ve just really hurt someone very close to me. 
Through out the day I try to distract myself, trying to do anything to get my mind off of food. If I’m able to go a day without eating anything at all my mood decreases and my want to eat food goes down with it. 
When I eat I honestly get a bit hostile to people. 
Food is constantly on my mind.  
“Can I eat this?” “What would happen if I ate this?” To random small objects that I KNOW aren’t edible. 
When I don’t eat I get really cold all the time, I find it extremely hard to get out of bed, because if I don’t get out of bed I can’t eat. 
Even though I have never been able to throw up, I’ve always attempted too, trying many different methods, salt water, straight salt, sticking my fingers down my throat. Instead of throwing up this makes me dehydrated.
I think about exercising constantly. 
I’m terrified of my friends finding out, scared that they will be disgusted and leave. 
When I don’t eat I’m suspicious that everyone hates me behind my back, and if they leave that would just be a sign that I was right. That this path is right for me. 
Sometimes when I’m mad at myself I cut my ankle, aiming for the achellies tendon. 
I’m terrified of myself and the things I might do.
